# Wasif Ali — Full-Stack Developer

> Portfolio of Wasif Ali, a Computer Science undergraduate at Air University Kamra and a full-stack developer building Flutter apps, Django backends, and websites that ship. His work pairs working software with honest evidence: what was built, what can be verified, and what the limits are.

## About

- Education: BS Computer Science, Air University — Aerospace & Aviation Campus Kamra (2024–2028), CGPA 3.47/4.00.
- Experience: Director IT at OASIS Foundation (May 2026–Present) — built oasisfoundation.net; Founder of GoSafar (Jun 2026–Present); Data Annotator, freelance & Fiverr (May 2024–Present); Intern at Pakistan Aeronautical Complex, AMF Kamra (Jun–Aug 2026, Grade A).
- Skills: C++, Java, C#, Dart, Python, SQL; Flutter, Blazor, Node.js, Express, jQuery; MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase; data annotation (bounding box, polygon, polyline, keypoint, segmentation, 3D cuboid); Git, VS Code, Android Studio.

## Selected projects

- Appointly: appointment booking with in-app chat and voice/video calls — Flutter + Django + MongoDB + WebRTC.
- OASIS Foundation Website: the public website of a student-led community-service organisation — https://oasisfoundation.net
- GoSafar: tours, group trips and rides across northern Pakistan — https://wasif-2005-ali.github.io/gosafar-website/
- EduRace: gamified MCQ learning and racing platform — Flutter + Firebase.
- University Course Management System, AccessDesk, Maze Explorer, Pharmacy Management System, Inventory Management System, Task & Appointment Management System: additional full-stack, desktop and coursework projects documented on the portfolio site and GitHub.
